glossary.definition: (1) "Peace officer" has the same meaning as in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4123.026 - Costs of post-exposure medical diagnostic services after peace officer, firefighter, emergency medical worker, or detention facility employees' exposure to blood or other body fluid.

glossary.definition: (2) "Firefighter" means a firefighter, whether paid or volunteer, of a lawfully constituted fire department.
glossary.source_title: Section 4123.026 - Costs of post-exposure medical diagnostic services after peace officer, firefighter, emergency medical worker, or detention facility employees' exposure to blood or other body fluid.

glossary.definition: (4) "Corrections officer" means a person employed by a detention facility as a corrections officer.
glossary.source_title: Section 4123.026 - Costs of post-exposure medical diagnostic services after peace officer, firefighter, emergency medical worker, or detention facility employees' exposure to blood or other body fluid.

glossary.definition:
(5) "Detention facility" means any public or private place used for the confinement of a person charged with or convicted of any crime in this state or another state or under the laws of the United States or alleged or found to be a delinquent child or unruly child in this state or another state or under the laws of the United States.
